title: reviewer: blocks a send the person named because of what its message says
note: Reviewer prompt blocked an honest report quoting an earlier block; fix added prompt rule, byte pin and eval fixtures; no case covered named sends quoting refusals.

title: Flaky test: hooks_offer a_failing_install_replaces_the_offer_and_starts_nothing times out waiting for hub exit
note: Local gate flake under load 8-9 on pty test; closed as duplicate, not planned.

title: tui: paging, scrolling, the width recount and the scroll bar don't wait for the opening pass
note: Search and copy checked pass_open but paging, wheel, resize recount and scroll bar did not; spec review of another PR found it; fix added screen tests.

title: tui: PageUp after a resume never reaches replies before the first history window
note: Reopened stream replay folded into live pages so earlier history never paged after resume; found by a new 41-turn pty regression test; paging and resume each tested alone.

title: Journey failure: lived_home_twenty_five_shadowed_notices_show_once_per_run
note: Post-merge journey fails repeatedly on focus-the-notice wait; not reproduced 20/20 under load; cause undetermined, product-vs-helper unresolved, still open; classified as probable test flake.

title: delegates: a running Fiber delegate refuses every session_message as closing
note: Delegates run through session.ask which closes admission at start, so sibling messages were refused; found by a red test in another lane's TUI work; fix added doors and binary tests.

title: tui: the approval card shows the model's arguments, not the ones a before_tool hook rewrote
note: Approval card read original call arguments while permission_requested carried none, so person approves something other than what runs; found in a preflight; fix added event fields and loop tests.

title: update: an older binary refuses a release that adds a first-party extension
note: Old binary's compiled-in short-name list rejected archives adding codemode, blocking fiber update; docs silent on unknown extensions; fix added archive-trust tests.

title: tui: a tool row shows the model's arguments, not the ones a before_tool hook rewrote
note: Tool rows rendered original arguments though tool_call_started carries rewritten ones; found during a drift re-verify; fix added pty, replay and screen tests.

title: tui: a swapped message stays clipped at its old width after a resize
note: Swapped call view wrote snapshot cells clipped instead of re-laying out on resize; no resize test for message rows; split from a drift review; fix added screen tests.

title: resumed session never idle-exits again (session.idle_exit_ms fires once)
note: Reported by tmux diagnosis run; three repro runs on main did not reproduce a missing second exit; closed not planned; cause unknown, TUI path untested.

title: Flaky tests: main::keeper
note: Keeper socket wait timed out once under load 15; fix only added connect-error diagnostics to the wait; root cause not established.

title: hub: the relay's from-session check only covers prompt, steer and reply, so a relayed sandbox command skips it
note: Relay hardcoded three commands while the socket refused more, so a sandbox-off command could pass from-session; found reading a sibling PR; fix shared one command set with drift tests.

title: A reload result does not report a provider whose model discovery failed
note: Discovery failures reached only a notice, not the reloaded event; split from a planning ticket as needing a contract decision; fix added extension_failures field.

title: delegates: a settled-from-log finish does not report the delegate's worktree
note: A resumed parent settling a delegate from its log left worktree None while live path set it; found by a lane reading code; fix added loop and binary tests.

title: delegates: trace when the parent's job watcher receives a delegate exit and when it delivers it
note: Diagnostic tracing ticket to explain a 2.5 hour late delegate notice; asks for debug traces, no product behaviour change.

title: fiber ask: a deadline in the prompt went unacted on where two other harnesses acted on it
note: Single live canary run where the model ignored a prompt deadline; likely model variance, needs billed rerun; closed not planned.

title: Hub refuses a prompt when an ancestor exits during the process walk
note: Process-ancestry walk refused a delegate lane's prompt when a short-lived parent exited mid-walk; found in a real switchyard run; fix added deterministic pause-point race test.

title: fiber ask: SIGINT exits 137 with no fiber_exited event; model ignored a prompt deadline
note: SIGINT on fiber ask exited 137 with no fiber_exited event in a canary run; closed not planned with no linked fix PR; deadline item split to another ticket.

title: A rejected or abandoned read still installs a transcript prefix
note: Rejected or abandoned history reads installed a partial transcript; found analysing another fix, no test covered it and no doc stated the intended behaviour.

title: tui: a reopening abandons a history wait without checking whose session it is
note: Reopen abandoned history waits by command id alone; only bites with two sessions resuming concurrently, which tests never exercised; found in a drift re-verify.

title: shell: stopping a process this session started is reviewed, and the reviewer refuses it
note: Field use: reviewer refused killing the agent's own service; no doc decided own-process stops are exempt; fixed by recording detached processes and fast-pathing owned kills.
